QuietDeck TV Launcher — Privacy policy
Effective 21 October 2026
Developer: Muhammad Junaid

QuietDeck requests no Android permissions, including INTERNET. It has no accounts, analytics, advertising SDKs, tracking or server connection.

Installed app names, package identifiers and artwork are processed on your device to display and launch apps. Favourites, hidden apps, collections, appearance and up to 12 recently opened app identifiers are stored locally. Android application backup is disabled.

Clear recent apps in Settings. Clear application storage or uninstall QuietDeck to delete its local settings. Exported backup files contain your configuration, exclude recent activity and wallpaper, and remain in the location you choose until you delete them. Importing a backup replaces the selected local settings.

A wallpaper you select is read through the Android document picker. Its document permission and address are retained locally so it can be displayed again. Removing the wallpaper stops its use; the original file is unchanged.

QuietDeck does not transmit or share this information. Other apps you open follow their own privacy policies. Android, Google Play and the file provider may process data under their own policies.

Support and privacy inquiries: github.com/junaid-devv/quietdeck-tv-launcher/issues (avoid posting personal data). Security reports: the repository’s private vulnerability reporting.

If these practices change, this policy and the store disclosures will be updated.
